caption: The editor of a New Campaign for The Complete Snowboard with the Strict & Compliant Strategy: the steps Choose Product, Apply a Discount, Marketing Strategy, Customer Reviews and Format are ticked and Landing Page Editor is step 6; the toolbar with Desktop, Mobile, Fields, Fonts and Regenerate All, the label Not saved yet, an empty dashed box Click to add banner image, and the first lines of the generated headline A Snowboard Designed for Riding Down Snow- next to a picture of the snowboard. The small account initial at the bottom left of the side menu is hidden.

The step Audiences of the same campaign, Audience Segments, with the text 2 approved: Seasonal Upgrade Seekers and First-Time Buyers are ticked and shown with a short description each, and Mountain Trip Planners and Gift-Giving Parents are not ticked. The small account initial at the bottom left of the side menu is hidden.

The step Audience Landing Pages (step 8): a panel Audiences, 2 of 2 ready, with Seasonal Upgrade Seekers and First-Time Buyers both Ready, and the page of First-Time Buyers in the editor with the headline Your First Snowboard: Honest Information to Help You Decide and again an empty box Click to add banner image. The small account initial at the bottom left of the side menu is hidden.

The last step, Review & Publish Your Landing Pages, with the text to review the campaign settings, publish to Shopify, or export the HTML package, the Campaign Name Complete Snowboard - Slope Ready Landing Page, the page URL slugs for the baseline page and both audience pages (each /pages/aw- and six characters) and the buttons Save & Exit, Back and Publish to Shopify; the cursor is on Publish to Shopify, which was not clicked. The small account initial at the bottom left of the side menu is hidden.
